theorems.name: GaussianInt.prime_of_nat_prime_of_mod_four_eq_three
theorems.closed: ⊢ ∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)], p % 4 = 3 → Prime ↑p

theorems.name: minpoly.natDegree_le
theorems.closed: ⊢ ∀ {K : Type u} [inst : Field K] {L : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (x : L) [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional K L], (minpoly K x).natDegree ≤ FiniteDimensional.finrank K L

theorems.name: IntermediateField.adjoin.finiteDimensional
theorems.closed: ⊢ ∀ {K : Type u} [inst : Field K] {L : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {x : L}, IsIntegral K x → FiniteDimensional K ↥K⟮x⟯

theorems.name: minpoly.degree_le
theorems.closed: ⊢ ∀ {K : Type u} [inst : Field K] {L : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (x : L) [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional K L], (minpoly K x).degree ≤ ↑(FiniteDimensional.finrank K L)

theorems.name: IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_adjoin_simple
theorems.closed: ⊢ ∀ {K : Type u} [inst : Field K] {L : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {x : L}, IsIntegral K x → Algebra.IsAlgebraic K ↥K⟮x⟯

theorems.name: IsGalois.of_card_aut_eq_finrank
theorems.closed: ⊢ ∀ (F : Type u_1) [inst : Field F] (E : Type u_2) [inst_1 : Field E] [inst_2 : Algebra F E] [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional F E], Fintype.card (E ≃ₐ[F] E) = FiniteDimensional.finrank F E → IsGalois F E

theorems.name: AlgHom.card
theorems.closed: ⊢ ∀ (F : Type u_1) (E : Type u_2) [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Field E] [inst_2 : Algebra F E] [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional F E] [inst_4 : IsSeparable F E] (K : Type u_3) [inst_5 : Field K] [inst_6 : IsAlgClosed K] [inst_7 : Algebra F K], Fintype.card (E →ₐ[F] K) = FiniteDimensional.finrank F E

theorems.name: IntermediateField.finrank_fixedField_eq_card
theorems.closed: ⊢ ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field E] [inst_2 : Algebra F E] (H : Subgroup (E ≃ₐ[F] E)) [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional F E] [inst_4 : DecidablePred fun x => x ∈ H], FiniteDimensional.finrank (↥(IntermediateField.fixedField H)) E = Fintype.card ↥H

theorems.name: IsGalois.card_fixingSubgroup_eq_finrank
theorems.closed: ⊢ ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field E] [inst_2 : Algebra F E] (K : IntermediateField F E) [inst_3 : DecidablePred fun x => x ∈ K.fixingSubgroup] [inst_4 : FiniteDimensional F E] [inst_5 : IsGalois F E], Fintype.card ↥K.fixingSubgroup = FiniteDimensional.finrank (↥K) E

theorems.name: hasSum_L_function_mod_four_eval_three
theorems.closed: ⊢ HasSum (fun n => 1 / ↑n ^ 3 * Real.sin (Real.pi * ↑n / 2)) (Real.pi ^ 3 / 32)

theorems.name: hasSum_geometric_two
theorems.closed: ⊢ HasSum (fun n => (1 / 2) ^ n) 2

theorems.name: hasSum_zeta_four
theorems.closed: ⊢ HasSum (fun n => 1 / ↑n ^ 4) (Real.pi ^ 4 / 90)

theorems.name: Real.sin_pi_div_six
theorems.closed: ⊢ Real.sin (Real.pi / 6) = 1 / 2

theorems.name: has_pointwise_sum_fourier_series_of_summable
theorems.closed: ⊢ ∀ {T : ℝ} [hT : Fact (0 < T)] {f : C(AddCircle T, ℂ)}, Summable (fourierCoeff ⇑f) → ∀ (x : AddCircle T), HasSum (fun i => fourierCoeff (⇑f) i • (fourier i) x) (f x)

theorems.name: hasSum_fourier_series_L2
theorems.closed: ⊢ ∀ {T : ℝ} [hT : Fact (0 < T)] (f : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 AddCircle.haarAddCircle)), HasSum (fun i => fourierCoeff (↑↑f) i • fourierLp 2 i) f

theorems.name: fourierCoeff.const_mul
theorems.closed: ⊢ ∀ {T : ℝ} [hT : Fact (0 < T)] (f : AddCircle T → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (n : ℤ), fourierCoeff (fun x => c * f x) n = c * fourierCoeff f n

theorems.name: fourierCoeff_toLp
theorems.closed: ⊢ ∀ {T : ℝ} [hT : Fact (0 < T)] (f : C(AddCircle T, ℂ)) (n : ℤ), fourierCoeff (↑↑((ContinuousMap.toLp 2 AddCircle.haarAddCircle ℂ) f)) n = fourierCoeff (⇑f) n
